learning: If the score is near 69.46, the restored controller is confirmed and the iteration 4 drop was the gain. If line loss begins near progress 0, start-up or entry speed is the cause, not the row edge. Read the progress at the first line-loss event on each track, as the Builder requested.
notes: Restores the iteration 3 and 5 controller (kp 1.2, kd 0.4, base_speed 1.1) on the ±0.03 m, 16 mm, y = 0.04 row. This is a confirmation race, so the expected score is about 69.46.
rationale: Iteration 5 reproduced the iteration 3 result (69.46) exactly on the ±0.03 m, 16 mm, y = 0.04 row with kp 1.2, kd 0.4, base_speed 1.1, ki 0 and last_direction line loss. The simulator is deterministic for a given geometry and controller, so this controller is the best-supported package. Iteration 4 changed kp to 1.0 and widened the row to ±0.04 m together, and progress fell on the s-bend (0.210 to 0.160) and oval (0.184 to 0.170). Line loss did not fall, so the lower gain is the more likely cause. Every run still ends off track near max error 0.062 m, which is the binding failure, and line loss persists at 1.0 to 1.1 events per run. In this iteration the Builder's geometry is the same ±0.03 m row, so I keep the restored controller unchanged. Changing kd, base_speed or the weights now would make this race a new controller test on a platform already measured, and the result would be harder to read. The purpose of this race is to confirm the restored controller. The next controller test should pair with the ±0.04 m row at kp 1.2, which the Builder plans for next iteration. I make no claim about how this package will score; the race will show it.
